name: santycss-resume-templates
description: Resume template marketplace: React + Vue 3 templates styled with SantyCSS, and the hosting server.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix react install && npm --prefix vue install
scripts.build: node ../build.js && npm --prefix react run build && npm --prefix vue run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && node ../scripts/check-classes.js --strict react/src vue/src web shared
